name: Gigiàt
body:
Gigiàt
CR 6

These enormous long-haired mountain goats resemble the nimble chamois, with coats of gray, brown, and white and long, back-curving black horns.

XP 2,400
LE Huge magical beast
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +8 natural, –2 size)
hp 68 (8d10+24)
Fort +9, Ref +9, Will +2
Resist cold 5

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee gore +12 (2d6+9 plus headbutt)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks powerful charge (gore, 4d6+18)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 16, Con 17, Int 12, Wis 14, Cha 11
Base Atk +8; CMB +16 (+20 bull rush); CMD 30 (32 vs. bull rush, 34 vs. trip)
Feats Dodge, Greater Bull Rush, Improved Bull Rush, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +4 (+14 to move on narrow surfaces), Climb +25, Survival +6; Racial Modifier +10 Acrobatics to move on narrow surfaces

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Headbutt (Ex)

When a gigiàt hits with its gore attack, as a free action it can make a bull rush combat maneuver against the same target.

Opponents who cannot move back due to a wall or other surface are knocked prone after moving the maximum possible distance.

Sure-Footed (Ex)

A gigiàt ignores movement reduction and skill penalties to Acrobatics, Climb, and Stealth for difficult terrain in rocky or icy terrain. It can run or charge through difficult terrain and can make a single turn of up to 90 degrees during a charge or run action.

ECOLOGY

Environment mountains
Organization solitary, band (3-5), or herd (15-20)
Treasure none

Gigiàts are herbivorous creatures and tend to avoid direct contact with humanoids but can become aggressive when spooked and may charge to attack before fleeing to higher ground, clambering on ledges that seem impossibly small for such a large creature. Those pursuing them onto the heights must beware of being knocked off their feet to fall to their doom.
